model_route: AE default primary gate + GAN online second-stage enhancement with local rule fallback
validation_scope: O2OA HTTP/REST JSON data interface stage acceptance scope; evidence is centered on cms_doc_list and related data interfaces.
description: O2OA first-platform default fuzzing profile. It keeps AE@1.0 as the first-stage gate and enables dynamic second-stage redundancy for uncertain samples.
result_description: Runner reports summary_dur20.csv, summary_dur60.csv, body_valid_stats_dur20.json and body_valid_stats_dur60.json when the runtime environment is available.
notes: O2OA default profile: AE@1.0 is the default acceptance gate. Samples in the gray zone trigger the GAN online second stage when available; otherwise DecisionEngine falls back to the local rule stage. GAN online is an enhancement path and does not replace AE as the default model.
runtime_requirements: NV_TOKEN must be available for real O2OA HTTP execution.
The AE score service should be started with model_stage/models/sefanogan_ae_model.pt and model_stage/models/sefanogan_ae_meta.json.
Optional GAN second-stage service can listen on unix:///tmp/nv_valid_gan.sock; if it is unavailable, DecisionEngine falls back to the built-in rule stage.
The local O2OA target and existing scripts/run_runner_real_fuzz_plan.sh path must be available.
